_comment: Colosseum deliberation-panel rosters. Installed to <project>/.colosseum/panel-profiles.json by colosseum_init --harness omp. Each seat is a RANKED candidate list resolved to the first AVAILABLE model by the colosseum-panel-resolver extension, which checks availability + enforces distinct model families via OMP ctx.models.family. Panel execution REQUIRES that extension and fails closed if it is absent; the stdlib panel_roster loader is diagnostics/tests only (declared_family labels, no availability or model-family check) and never resolves a live panel. Capacity note (2026-07): the reliable frontier seats are openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol (OpenAI) and glm-5.2 (Zhipu); claude-fable-5 (Anthropic) and kimi-k3 (Moonshot) are intermittently at capacity. The active roster is therefore the two available families with min_families=2; when Fable and Kimi-k3 return, add the pending seats in _pending_seats and raise min_families. No substitute models (opus/kimi-2.6) are used; a seat resolves to its named frontier model or the run reports its absence. declared_family is a stable persisted label; the opaque OMP family token is never persisted. OMP routes are uncalibrated (calibration: pending).
